page.body:
Managing Listings

Changing property status

Estimated reading: 2 minutes 689 views

Whether you’ve rented your property or it’s sold, you’ll need to update its status to reflect its availability. This process allows you to mark your listing as unavailable, pending, or sold. This helps potential renters or buyers see the current state of the property and ensures your listing is accurate. It’s a quick and easy step to keep your property information up-to-date. This is imperative to the PropertyList Network so make sure to do this promptly. Accurate listings are essential for a smooth user experience and connecting you with qualified renters or buyers.

  • Click the tab “MY LISTINGS” => find the property you wish to update => click the “OPTIONS” tab=> in this dropdown you will find:

    RESERVE: A reservation deposit has been received and all parties have signed the reservation agreement. This property is currently unavailable for other offers or viewings.

    REGISTER SALE:     The sale of this property has been finalised at the notary’s office. Congratulations!

    TAKE OFFLINE:     The property is currently unavailable and will be hidden in the mls & from public view. You can bring it back online later.

    DELETE:     This will permanently remove the property from the system. You won’t be able to recover it. Use with caution!

     

You can also “FEATURE YOUR PROPERTY” in the MLS or Property Portal. Find out how here!
